name: Nepalese Vegetable Thukpa
ingredients: 1 carrot, 1 cup cabbage and ½ cup green beans, sliced
3 garlic cloves, 2.5 cm ginger, 1 green chilli
1 tsp soy sauce and ½ tsp cumin
steps: Heat the oil and fry the garlic, ginger and chilli for 1 minute. Add the cumin.
Add the stock, carrot and beans and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the tofu and cabbage and cook for 4 minutes.
Cook the noodles separately for 5 minutes and drain.
Divide the noodles into two bowls, ladle over the soup and finish with soy sauce, pepper, spring onion, coriander and lime.
note: A warming Himalayan noodle soup; cooking the noodles separately stops the broth turning starchy.
